name: duplicate_order
root_cause_statement: The same razorpay_order_id appears twice in merchant_orders.csv under two different order_refs (MORD-02 and MORD-02-DUP), both pointing to the same real Razorpay order — a genuine upload duplication, not two separate orders.
evidence_notes: Both merchant_orders.csv rows, the single matching Razorpay order.
